cleanup.treadAndHiddenCap: Explicit palette fill; no body/fender sampling

decisions: Independent long-body bus; original east/right-side door and west/opposite-side window paint are separate owners.
Roof ventilation artwork is north-owned; opposing source roof depth/vent placement and mirror projections may disagree.
All source crops, per-axle wheel wells and registration are retained. Only neutral steering is supported; nonzero steering is unqualified.
Roof shoulders use an explicit roof-palette fill so source vent/window edges do not replay across separate surfaces; corner faces close the roof/end joins.

Bus B source north removes seven left-mirror pixels and three upper right-mirror pixels; separate side mirror dimensions preserve this variation. Other source views repeat the earlier mirror shape, an explicit projection discrepancy.
limits: Affine owned UV paint is cleaned authoring, not ray-visible recovery. Own projection/coverage remains separate.
